transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Doctor, naaku two days nunchi stomach pain undi chaala. Nenu last week anukunta biryani thinnaanu, koncham masala food thinnaanu, maybe adhe anukunta. But severe pain undi stomach lopala, koncham burning sensation ala undi.

transcript.speaker: Doctor
transcript.text: Avuna? So meeru emanna medicine vaadaara?

transcript.speaker: Patient
transcript.text: Ledhu doctor, nenu em medicine theesukoledhu.

transcript.speaker: Doctor
transcript.text: Okay, nenu konni medicines raasi isthaanu, avi vaadi chudandi.

summary.consultation_overview: Patient presented with a 2-day history of severe stomach pain and a burning sensation, suspected by the patient to be related to consuming spicy masala food/biryani last week. Doctor decided to prescribe medications.
summary.history_of_present_illness: Patient reports severe stomach pain and burning sensation inside the stomach for the past 2 days. Mentions having eaten spicy biryani/masala food last week. Patient has not taken any medication for symptom relief.
summary.treatment_plan: Doctor mentioned prescribing medications, but specific medication names and instructions were not stated.
